title: CycleCare comprehensive daily logging redesign
scope: Design and interaction prototype only; not the Flutter implementation

field_semantics.not_logged: Missing/null/empty is no observation, never automatically a negative finding.
field_semantics.none: Explicit observation of none where an appropriate choice is present.
field_semantics.unknown: Not sure/unclear is an explicit uncertain observation; never converted to negative.
field_semantics.single_mood: Current model stores one mood. Multi-mood persistence is future work.
field_semantics.optional: Every health observation is optional. Do not silently save the example values in production.
field_semantics.legacy_migrations: painLevel, waterMl and medicineTaken currently conflate default/absent values; implement proper optional states and migrations before shipping this UI.

required_storage_first: Add nullable observation semantics and migrate existing data without inventing history.
Add explicit fields and serialization for planned structured features.
Update export/import schema, validation and local encryption/privacy rules where applicable.
Preserve custom symptom tags and all existing values.
Then build the unified redesigned Flutter controls, selection summaries and reduced-motion transitions.
